_note: Generated from the decompiled v0.107.1 classes and updated for game v0.111.0 from the decompiled v0.111.0 classes for the 3-turn training-dummy simulator; spec in README.md.

CARD.ABRASIVE.note: Dexterity + Thorns only (enemy never attacks); Sly

CARD.ABUNDANCE.note: Pick 1 of 3 random upgraded class Powers into hand, free this turn.

CARD.AGGRESSION.note: Each later turn start (before draw) a RANDOM Attack from discard goes to hand and is upgraded; op picks the best.

CARD.ALCHEMIZE.note: Procures a random potion (could be a damage potion); not modeled.

CARD.ALL_FOR_ONE.note: Returns cards whose CURRENT cost is 0; X-cost and Status/Curse cards are excluded by code.

CARD.ANOINTED.note: Every Rare card in draw pile goes to hand (hand cap 10).

play.note: +1 Strength (permanent) whenever you generate a card

CARD.ARSENAL.note: +1 Str (permanent) each time you generate a card in combat (first forge's blade, Debris, colorless, transforms). Needs onGenerate.

CARD.AUTOMATION.note: Every 10 cards drawn after it is played (turn draws included): +1 energy.

CARD.BANSHEES_CRY.note: costExpr: -2 per Ethereal card played this combat (counts plays before it was drawn). costExprUp = upgraded version

CARD.BEACON_OF_HOPE.note: Multiplayer only: shares gained block with allies.

CARD.BEAT_DOWN.note: Plays 3 (4) random playable Attacks from discard pile for free.

CARD.BEAT_INTO_SHAPE.note: Forge 5(7) + 5(7) per attack hit on the target earlier this turn (this card's own hits excluded).

CARD.BECKON.note: No play effect; self HP loss if left in hand at end of turn.

CARD.BEGONE.note: Transforms 1 chosen hand card into Minion Strike; transformInHand has no n, so modelled as exhaust 1 + add.

CARD.BELIEVE_IN_YOU.note: Multiplayer only: 2 (3) energy to another player; cannot target self.

CARD.BIASED_COGNITION.note: Loses 1 Focus at the start of each later turn (BiasedCognitionPower).

CARD.BLACK_HOLE.note: 3(4) dmg to all enemies per star-gain event and per card play that spent >0 stars (fires once per card, after it).

CARD.BLADE_OF_INK.note: Inky Shivs (+1 dmg each, Weak): +1 given to the first 2 (3) Shivs played this turn, not to these exact Shivs

CARD.BLADE_SYMPHONY.note: Multiplayer only: every living player (incl. you) gets 2 Shivs in hand; the allies' Shivs are not simulated.

CARD.BLAZE.note: Multiplayer only: 5 (7) Strength to another player; cannot target self. No allies in sim.

CARD.BLIGHT_STRIKE.note: Doom = damage the hit dealt; onHit is registered before the attack so it catches this card's own hit

CARD.BODY_SLAM.note: Damage = current Block. The sim adds up gainBlock amounts; Dexterity and other block modifiers are not applied, so it can be low.

CARD.BOLAS.note: Returns to hand at the start of the next turn.

CARD.BOMBARDMENT.note: Exhausts; while in exhaust pile it auto-plays itself free (random target) at the start of each of your turns.

CARD.BONE_SHARDS.note: Osty hits ALL enemies, then Osty is killed (fires onOstyLoseHp). Does nothing if Osty is dead

CARD.BORROWED_TIME.note: Every card of yours costs +1 for the rest of this turn

CARD.BOUNCING_FLASK.note: 3 poison to a random enemy, 3 (4) separate applications (each counts for Outbreak); one enemy gets all

CARD.BRAND.note: HP loss happens first in game; placed last so Rupture's after-card Strength timing is matched.

CARD.BREAKTHROUGH.note: HP loss happens before the attack in game; placed last because Rupture grants its Strength only after the card.

CARD.BUBBLE_BUBBLE.note: applies poison only if the target already has poison (a 0 application must not count as an apply)

CARD.BULK_UP.note: Slot removal drops the newest orb(s) over capacity WITHOUT evoking them.

CARD.BULLET_TIME.note: X-cost cards in hand are not made free

CARD.BUNDLE_OF_JOY.note: 3(4) random distinct Colorless cards to hand (not upgraded). Exhaust.

CARD.BURST.note: unused replays are removed at end of turn

CARD.CACOPHONY.note: Multiplayer only: every 33 cards drawn after it is played (turn draws included): 66 (99) unpowered damage to a random enemy. In game the allies' draws count too; no allies in sim.

CARD.CALAMITY.note: Each Attack you play adds a random class Attack to hand.

CARD.CALCULATED_GAMBLE.note: discard whole hand, draw that many (handSize read once before the discard)

CARD.CALL_OF_THE_VOID.note: Generated card also gets Ethereal (no op) and is never Basic/Ancient

CARD.CAPTURE_SPIRIT.note: Damage is unblockable/unpowered (no Str/Vuln). Souls go to random draw-pile positions

CARD.CATASTROPHE.note: Game auto-plays 2 (3) random non-Unplayable cards of the draw pile; modeled as playing the top cards.

CARD.CHAOS.note: Random orb is uniform over the 5 orb types (OrbModel.GetRandomOrb).

CARD.CHARGE.note: Transforms 2 chosen draw-pile cards into Minion Dive Bomb (in place); no draw-pile transform op, so exhaust 2 + add 2.

CARD.CHILL.note: Channels 1 Frost per enemy (1 vs the dummy).

CARD.CINDER.note: The exhausted hand card is random (pick:random).

CARD.CLASH.note: Playable only if every other card in hand is an Attack.

CARD.CLAW.note: After the hit, every Claw gets +2 (+3 if the played Claw is upgraded) for the rest of combat.

CARD.CLEANSE.note: Player chooses the draw-pile card to exhaust (pick the least useful)

CARD.CONCOCT.note: Multiplayer only: another player's attacks this turn also apply 3 (4) Poison; cannot target self. No allies in sim.

CARD.CONQUEROR.note: Debuff on target: blade deals x2 this turn. Two Conquerors in one turn stay x2 (not x4) and the 2nd stack lasts into next turn.

CARD.CONSTELLATION.note: Multiplayer only: another player draws 1, gains 1 energy and 9 (12) Block; cannot target self. Nothing for you.

CARD.CONSUMING_SHADOW.note: The end-of-turn evoke happens AFTER that turn's orb passives (AfterSideTurnEnd).

CARD.COORDINATE.note: Multiplayer only: temp Strength 5 (8) to another player; cannot target self.

CARD.COSMIC_INDIFFERENCE.note: Puts 1 chosen discard-pile card on top of draw pile; no op for discard->draw top (not modelled).

CARD.COUNTDOWN.note: Doom goes to a random enemy (single enemy = exact)

CARD.CRASH_LANDING.note: Fills hand up to 10 cards with Debris (Status).

CARD.CREATIVE_AI.note: Before the draw each later turn; uniform over Defect Powers of Common/Uncommon/Rare (no Ancient), normal cost.

CARD.CRESCENT_SPEAR.note: Count = cards with a star cost (incl. star-X) in all piles + hand, INCLUDING this card itself.

CARD.CRIMSON_MANTLE.note: Each later turn start: lose 1 HP then gain Block (only matters for Rupture/Inferno/Juggernaut triggers).

CARD.DANSE_MACABRE.note: Block only (EnergyVar 2 = cost threshold for the block)

CARD.DARKNESS.note: Each Dark orb's passive: its evoke dmg +6+Focus.

CARD.DEATHBRINGER.note: Doom + Weak to all enemies; Weak kept only as a debuff application (Sleight of Flesh)

CARD.DEBILITATE.note: Vuln x2.0 for 2 (up 3) turns, removed via nested nextTurn. Game doubles the bonus part and does not stack a 2nd copy

CARD.DECISIONS_DECISIONS.note: Auto-plays ONE chosen hand Skill 3 times free; playFromHand has no 'times' field yet (else it is played once). Exhaust.

CARD.DEFY.note: Weak kept only as a debuff application (Sleight of Flesh)

CARD.DEMESNE.note: +1 hand draw and +1 max energy on every later turn

CARD.DEMONIC_SHIELD.note: Multiplayer-only; gives an ally Block equal to yours (not your own Block, so no gainBlock).

CARD.DIRGE.note: Summon repeated X times; X Souls (upgraded if Dirge is) into random draw-pile positions

CARD.DISCOVERY.note: Best of 3 random class cards, free this turn.

CARD.DISINTEGRATION.note: Knowledge Demon boss-choice card (applies a debuff power to you); never in your deck.

CARD.DISTRACTION.note: Random class Skill, free this turn.

CARD.DOMINATE.note: Strength = target's Vulnerable after applying (var is read before the first op).

CARD.DOUBLE_ENERGY.note: Gains energy equal to current energy (after paying this card).

CARD.DOUBT.note: End of turn in hand: you are Weak (attacks x0.75) during your next turn.

CARD.DREDGE.note: Hand cap 10 limits how many come back

CARD.DRUM_OF_BATTLE.note: Energy only when this card itself gets exhausted.

CARD.DUALCAST.note: Evokes the front orb twice. No orbs = nothing.

CARD.DUAL_WIELD.note: Adds 1 (2) copies of the best Attack/Power in hand.

CARD.ECHOING_SLASH.note: repeats once per enemy killed; dummy assumed not to die

CARD.ECHO_FORM.note: First card each turn is played twice; Echo Form itself counts as the first card on the turn it is played.

CARD.EIDOLON.note: Auto-plays every playable Ethereal card in your exhaust pile; no op plays cards from the exhaust pile.

CARD.ENERGY_SURGE.note: MultiplayerOnly; every player (incl. you) gains the energy.

CARD.ENFEEBLING_TOUCH.note: Enemy -8 (up -11) Str this turn: irrelevant vs dummy, but its Str-loss counts as a debuff for Sleight of Flesh

CARD.ENLIGHTENMENT.note: Cards in hand cost at most 1 this turn (upgraded: rest of combat).

CARD.ENTHRALLED.note: Must be played (2 energy, no effect) before any other card while in hand.

play.note: each later turn start: transform 1 chosen hand card into a random card

CARD.ENTROPY.note: Each later turn start: transform 1 chosen card in hand into a random card.

CARD.ENVENOM.note: per attack hit that deals unblocked dmg (dummy has no block)

CARD.EQUILIBRIUM.note: Block + keep the whole hand at end of this turn.

CARD.EVIL_EYE.note: Second Block gain only if a card was exhausted this turn; a 0-amount gainBlock must not fire onGainBlock.

CARD.EXPECT_A_FIGHT.note: Block only: 15 (16) plus 5 (8) per Strength you have.

CARD.EXPERTISE.note: The drawn cards also get Retain for this turn; that Retain is not simulated.

CARD.EXPOSE.note: also strips enemy block and Artifact

CARD.FADE.note: Multiplayer only: 6 (9) temporary Dexterity to another player; cannot target self.

CARD.FAN_OF_KNIVES.note: its power makes Shivs hit all enemies (no effect vs one enemy)

play.note: each turn the first N Attacks played for 0 energy go to hand instead of discard

CARD.FERAL.note: Needs an attack-AND-paid-0 filter and a played-card-to-hand op.

CARD.FETCH.note: Draw only on the first play of this card this turn and only if Osty is alive

CARD.FIEND_FIRE.note: hits = hand size read before the exhaust (cards drawn by exhaust triggers do not count).

CARD.FIGHT_ME.note: Also gives the enemy 1 Strength (irrelevant vs dummy).

CARD.FINISHER.note: hits = attacks already played this turn, not counting this card

CARD.FLAK_CANNON.note: Before hitting it exhausts all those Statuses (hand/draw/discard); exhaust not expressible, so a 2nd Flak overcounts.

CARD.FLANKING.note: multiplayer only; doubles OTHER players' attack damage vs target

CARD.FLATTEN.note: Costs 0 for the rest of the turn once Osty has attacked this turn

CARD.FOREGONE_CONCLUSION.note: Next turn, before the hand draw (shuffles first if needed): put 2(3) chosen draw-pile cards into hand.

CARD.FRANTIC_ESCAPE.note: Sandpit fight only; cost +1 each play.

CARD.FRIENDSHIP.note: +1 max energy on every later turn; Strength loss does not affect Osty attacks

CARD.FTL.note: Draws 1 only if <3 (<4 up) cards were played earlier this turn.

CARD.GANG_UP.note: Multiplayer only: +5 (+7) per hit allies dealt to target this turn; no allies in sim.

CARD.GLIMMER.note: Draws 3(4) then puts 1 chosen hand card on top of draw pile; no put-back op, so net draw 2(3).

CARD.GLIMPSE_BEYOND.note: Multiplayer-only; every living player (incl. you) gets the Souls

CARD.GOLD_AXE.note: Dmg = card plays finished earlier this combat (replays count).

CARD.GO_FOR_THE_EYES.note: Weak only if enemy intends to attack; weak omitted anyway.

CARD.GUARDS.note: Transforms ANY chosen hand cards into Minion Sacrifice (0-cost block Skill); modelled as the obvious picks: Defends + clog cards.

CARD.GUIDING_STAR.note: The draw is next turn (added to the hand draw).

CARD.HAILSTORM.note: Needs >=1 Frost orb at end of turn; hits all enemies.

CARD.HAMMER_TIME.note: Multiplayer only: your forges also forge for allies.

CARD.HAND_TRICK.note: gives one Skill in hand Sly this turn (autoplays if discarded); no op to grant Sly, ignored

CARD.HANG.note: Hang on target doubles per Hang play: this play deals x2^(earlier Hang plays). Hang is also a debuff (Sleight of Flesh)

CARD.HAUNT.note: Unblockable non-attack damage to a random enemy

CARD.HAZE.note: All enemies; Weak only fires debuff triggers.

CARD.HEADBUTT.note: Also puts a chosen discard-pile card on top of the draw pile; no op for discard->draw top.

CARD.HEAVENLY_DRILL.note: Hits X; doubled to 2X when X>=4.

CARD.HEIRLOOM_HAMMER.note: Then copies 1 chosen Colorless hand card into hand; filter 'colorless' is not in the filter grammar yet.

CARD.HELIX_DRILL.note: Hits = energy spent earlier this turn (X costs included).

CARD.HELLO_WORLD.note: Before each later turn's hand draw: a random Common class card to hand.

CARD.HEMOKINESIS.note: HP loss happens before the attack in game; placed last because Rupture grants its Strength only after the card.

CARD.HIBERNATE.note: Multiplayer only: until your next turn your Frost orbs also give Block to the other players (Block is not simulated).

CARD.HIDDEN_GEM.note: A random Attack/Skill/Power in draw pile gets Replay +2 (+3) permanently; no op for that.

CARD.HOWL_FROM_BEYOND.note: If exhausted it auto-plays itself at end of that turn, then goes to discard; modeled as immediate attack.

CARD.HUDDLE_UP.note: Multiplayer only; every player including you draws.

CARD.HYPERBEAM.note: The 3 Focus loss lasts this turn only.

CARD.IGNITION.note: MultiplayerOnly: needs another living player, so never playable solo. In co-op it channels Plasma for the chosen ally.

CARD.IMITATION_LEARNING.note: Multiplayer only: the next 2 (3) Power cards the chosen player plays are also auto-played for you. No allies in sim, so it does nothing here.

CARD.IMPATIENCE.note: Draws only if no Attack is in hand.

CARD.INFERNO.note: Dmg hits all enemies. 2 Infernos in game = one 2-HP tick + one 12 hit; the ops give 2 ticks x 2 triggers.

CARD.INTERCEPT.note: Multiplayer only: block and cover for an ally.

CARD.ITERATION.note: First Status drawn each turn (turn-start draw included) draws N.

CARD.JACKPOT.note: Game adds 3 random 0-cost class cards (upgraded if upgraded); no zeroCost random filter, so class|any free.

CARD.JUGGERNAUT.note: Damage to a random enemy on every Block gain > 0.

CARD.JUGGLING.note: 3rd Attack each turn adds a COPY of that Attack to hand; no op to clone the triggering card, random Attack used.

CARD.KINGLY_KICK.note: Costs 1 less for the rest of combat each time this card is drawn.

CARD.KINGLY_PUNCH.note: Gains +4(6) dmg for the rest of combat each time this card is drawn.

CARD.KNIFE_TRAP.note: game autoplays each exhausted Shiv (they stay in exhaust); modeled as that many 0-cost Shivs added to hand

CARD.KNOCKDOWN.note: Multiplayer only; its debuff multiplies other players' attacks only.

CARD.KNOCKOUT_BLOW.note: +5 stars only if the hit kills the target (never vs the dummy), hence 5*0.

CARD.LARGESSE.note: Multiplayer only: gives a random Colorless card to an ally (nothing for you).

CARD.LETHALITY.note: First Attack card each turn x1.5 (up x1.75); none this turn if an Attack was already played. Replays excluded

CARD.LIFT.note: Multiplayer only: block to another player.

CARD.LIGHTNING_ROD.note: Power has 2 charges (next 2 turn starts); exact within the 3-turn window.

CARD.LOOP.note: Game runs it right after the turn-start draw; order does not matter for orb passives.

CARD.MAD_SCIENCE.note: Type/rider set by event (TinkerTime). Default Attack 12 shown; riders: Vuln 2, 3 hits, draw 3, 2 energy, etc.

CARD.MAKE_IT_SO.note: Code: on 3rd/6th.. Skill of the turn, if not in hand, returns from ANY pile, even before first play. Modelled only after play.

CARD.MALAISE.note: enemy loses Strength / gains Weak; no effect on damage dealt

CARD.MANGLE.note: Enemy temporary Strength loss is irrelevant vs dummy.

CARD.MANIFEST_AUTHORITY.note: Random Colorless card to hand (upgraded if this is upgraded).

play.note: each Skill you play gains Sly permanently (autoplays when later discarded by an effect)

CARD.MASTER_PLANNER.note: grants Sly to played Skills; no op to grant a keyword

CARD.MAUL.note: Each Maul play gives all Mauls +2 (+3) dmg; mixing upgraded and base Mauls is slightly off.

CARD.MAYHEM.note: Plays the top card of the draw pile at each later turn start (after the hand draw).

CARD.MELANCHOLY.note: Block only (EnergyVar 1 = its own cost reduction when a creature dies)

CARD.METAMORPHOSIS.note: 3 (5) random class Attacks shuffled into draw pile at random spots; they cost 0 for the combat.

CARD.MIDNIGHT.note: Multiplayer only: costs 1 less for each card exhausted this combat (any player's, from the combat history). Sim uses your exhaust pile size.

CARD.MIMIC.note: Multiplayer only: block equal to an ally's block.

CARD.MIND_ROT.note: Knowledge Demon boss-choice card (applies a debuff power to you); never in your deck.

CARD.MISERY.note: Copies target's debuffs to other enemies (irrelevant vs one enemy)

CARD.MOLTEN_FIST.note: Doubles target's Vulnerable; with 0 Vulnerable nothing is applied (a 0-amount op must not fire onApply).

CARD.MONOLOGUE.note: The +1 Str is gained AFTER each later card resolves (that card does not benefit); all removed at end of turn.

CARD.MULTI_CAST.note: Evokes the front orb X (X+1 up) times; X=0 unupgraded does nothing.

CARD.NEOWS_FURY.note: Returns up to 2 (3) chosen discard-pile cards to hand (hand cap 10).

CARD.NEUROSURGE.note: Also applies 3 Doom to YOU each later turn start (harmless within 3 turns)

play.note: choose a card in hand now; at start of next turn (before the draw) add 3 copies of it to hand

CARD.NIGHTMARE.note: copies a hand card chosen now into next turn's hand; copyInHand runs at once, nextTurn sees an empty hand

CARD.NORMALITY.note: While in hand you can play at most 3 cards per turn.

CARD.NOSTALGIA.note: First Attack/Skill played each turn goes on top of draw pile; assumes an unused one lapses at end of turn.

CARD.OBLIVION.note: Not for Oblivion itself. Oblivion is also a debuff on the target (Sleight of Flesh)

CARD.OMNISLICE.note: Also splashes the same damage to other enemies.

CARD.ONE_FOR_ALL.note: Multiplayer only: every player (incl. you) deals +3 (+4) with Attacks played for 0 energy (not X). Sim: printed 0-cost cards only; in game free plays and cost cuts count too.

CARD.ONE_TWO_PUNCH.note: Expires at end of this turn.

CARD.ORBIT.note: +1 energy for every 4 energy spent (cumulative over the combat from when played). Needs onEnergySpent/energySpentThisCombat.

CARD.OUTBREAK.note: All enemies: apply 9 (12) Poison, then Poison ticks once right away. Sim: one tick for the full amount, without the stack loss or extra Accelerant ticks.

CARD.OUTMANEUVER.note: Gain 2 (3) energy at start of next turn only; no one-shot next-turn op.

CARD.OUTRAGE.note: Multiplayer only: after the hit every living player (incl. you) gets a copy in the discard pile; the allies' copies are not simulated.

CARD.PACTS_END.note: Attacks only if 3+ cards are in the exhaust pile (hits 0 otherwise).

CARD.PALE_BLUE_DOT.note: +1(2) hand draw on turns after a turn with >=5 cards played.

CARD.PANACHE.note: Every 5th card played in a turn deals 10 (14) to all; the count resets each turn (fresh turn trigger each turn).

CARD.PARTICLE_WALL.note: Block only; returns to hand after play.

CARD.PHANTOM_BLADES.note: first Shiv each turn; also gives Shivs Retain (irrelevant: 0-cost Shivs are always played)

CARD.PHOTON_CUT.note: Draws 1(2) then puts 1 chosen hand card on top of draw pile; no put-back op, so net draw 0(1).

CARD.PILLAGE.note: Draws until a non-Attack is drawn (or hand full); no draw-until op, modeled as draw 2.

CARD.PLOT.note: Multiplayer only: every living player (incl. you) draws 2 (3) more cards next turn.

CARD.POUNCE.note: free Skill persists across turns until a Skill is played

CARD.PREDATOR.note: game adds 2 to the turn-start hand draw (should not trigger Speedster)

CARD.PREP_TIME.note: Vigor 4 (6) at the start of each later turn.

CARD.PROTECTOR.note: Game uses Osty MAX HP; equals current HP vs the dummy (nothing damages Osty)

CARD.PULL_FROM_BELOW.note: 0 hits if no Ethereal card was played yet this combat

CARD.PURITY.note: Exhausts up to 3 (5) chosen cards from hand (e.g. statuses); not modeled.

CARD.PUTREFY.note: Weak kept only as a debuff application (Sleight of Flesh)

CARD.PYRE.note: Raises max energy, so it applies from the next turn.

CARD.QUADCAST.note: Evokes the front orb 4 times. No orbs = nothing.

CARD.QUASAR.note: Pick 1 of 3 random Colorless cards (upgraded if this is upgraded) into hand.

CARD.RADIATE.note: Divine Right's combat-start stars count as turn-1 gains (history round 1, player side). Its StarsVar(1) is unused.

CARD.RALLY.note: Multiplayer only: block to every player.

CARD.RAMPAGE.note: Growth is per card instance in game; the per-id counter matches unless the deck has 2+ Rampages.

CARD.RATTLE.note: One count per earlier Osty attack command this turn (not per hit)

CARD.REBOUND.note: Next card played this turn goes on top of draw pile; the effect lapses at end of turn.

CARD.RELAX.note: Next turn only: +2 (3) cards drawn and +2 (3) energy; no one-shot next-turn op.

CARD.REND.note: +5 (+8) per non-temporary debuff type on target; Weak would also count but is not simulated.

CARD.RESTLESSNESS.note: Works only if it is the only card in hand (has Retain).

CARD.RIGHT_HAND_HAND.note: Returns from discard to hand whenever you play a card that spent 2+ energy; no op for a card-in-discard trigger

CARD.ROCKET_PUNCH.note: Real trigger is live from combat start (card hook), not only after its first play.

CARD.ROLLING_BOULDER.note: Each later turn start: N dmg to all, then N+=5. Nested perTurn adds the +5 per turn growth.

CARD.RUPTURE.note: HP loss during a card play grants Strength after that card; self-damage cards put loseHp last to match.

CARD.SACRIFICE.note: Kills Osty for block (Calculation vars = block); with Necro Mastery that deals Osty's HP

CARD.SCAVENGE.note: Must exhaust 1 chosen card from hand if any.

CARD.SCRAPE.note: Really discards only the DRAWN cards that do not cost 0 (X counts as not 0); est. 1 kept.

CARD.SCULPTING_STRIKE.note: Then gives Ethereal to 1 chosen non-Ethereal hand card (Ethereal synergies); no op to add a keyword in hand

CARD.SEANCE.note: Transforms 1 chosen draw-pile card into a Soul; modeled as remove 1 + add 1 Soul to draw

CARD.SECOND_WIND.note: Exhausts every non-Attack in hand (filter). The game gains Block once per exhausted card (Juggernaut fires per card); one gainBlock here.

CARD.SEEKING_EDGE.note: Its power makes Sovereign Blade hit all enemies (no effect vs one enemy).

CARD.SERPENT_FORM.note: unpowered dmg to a random enemy after each card you play

CARD.SHADOW_STEP.note: x2 does not stack with a 2nd Shadow Step (it extends to 2 turns instead)

CARD.SHARED_FATE.note: Enemy -2 (up -3) Str: irrelevant vs dummy, but counts as a debuff for Sleight of Flesh

CARD.SHATTER.note: Each orb, front first, is evoked twice and removed.

CARD.SHINING_STRIKE.note: After this play the card itself goes on TOP of the draw pile instead of discard (unless it exhausts).

CARD.SHIV.note: With Fan of Knives it hits all enemies.

CARD.SHOCKWAVE.note: Also Weak (omitted); applies to all enemies.

CARD.SIC_EM.note: Trigger registered even if Osty is dead; Sic 'Em's own hit does not summon. Also a debuff (Sleight of Flesh)

CARD.SIGNAL_BOOST.note: Next Power card is played twice.

CARD.SLEIGHT_OF_FLESH.note: Game also fires on Hang, Debilitate, Sic 'Em, Oblivion and enemy Str loss (no debuff op for those)

CARD.SLOTH.note: Knowledge Demon boss-choice card (applies a debuff power to you); never in your deck.

CARD.SMOKESTACK.note: Unpowered damage to all enemies per Status card you create.

CARD.SNAP.note: Then gives Retain to 1 chosen hand card; no op to add a keyword in hand

CARD.SNEAKY.note: multiplayer only; block when allies play attacks

CARD.SOULBOUND.note: Multiplayer only: each Soul you create also gives the chosen player a Soul in their draw pile; nothing for you.

CARD.SOVEREIGN_BLADE.note: Base 10; forge ops add to it (sim rule).

CARD.SPECTRUM_SHIFT.note: Each later turn, before the hand draw: 1 random Colorless card to hand.

CARD.SPEEDSTER.note: unpowered dmg to all enemies per card drawn during your turn outside the turn-start draw

CARD.SPLASH.note: Real pool is OTHER characters' Attacks (best of 3, free this turn); no other-class random token.

CARD.SPORE_MIND.note: No effect; costs 1 to exhaust it.

CARD.SPUR.note: Also heals Osty (irrelevant: Osty is at full HP vs dummy)

CARD.SQUEEZE.note: Count must exclude this Squeeze itself (code: other OstyAttack-tagged cards in all piles)

CARD.STAMPEDE.note: At each turn end (incl. this one) auto-plays a random playable Attack left in hand.

CARD.STARDUST.note: Star-X (catalog misses it): spends all stars, X = stars spent; costs 0 energy.

CARD.STOKE.note: n = hand size read before the exhaust.

CARD.STONE_ARMOR.note: Plating: Block at each turn end, amount decays 1 per turn (amount irrelevant; only Juggernaut cares).

CARD.STORM.note: Triggers after each later Power card resolves.

CARD.STORM_OF_STEEL.note: discard hand, add that many Shivs (handSize read once before the discard)

CARD.STRANGLE.note: unblockable dmg per card played later this turn

CARD.STRATAGEM.note: Whenever the draw pile is reshuffled: put 1 chosen draw-pile card into hand.

CARD.SUMMON_FORTH.note: Moves every blade not in hand to hand (code also takes exhausted blades - rare), then forges.

CARD.SUNDER.note: +3 energy only if it kills; omitted (dummy never dies).

CARD.SUPERMASSIVE.note: Counts every card you generated this combat: forge-created blade, Debris, colorless, and transform results.

CARD.SWEEPING_GAZE.note: Osty attacks a random enemy; does nothing if Osty is dead.

CARD.SWORD_SAGE.note: Blade is replayed +1 time per stack (2 stacks = x3, not x4); a replay = full 2nd attack, so vigor only hits once.

CARD.SYNTHESIS.note: Next Power played from hand costs 0 (any later turn too).

CARD.TAG_TEAM.note: Multiplayer only: next ally Attack on target is played twice; no allies in sim.

CARD.TANK.note: Multiplayer-only; you take x1.5 attack damage and the other players are Guarded.

CARD.TESLA_COIL.note: Lightning passives (3+Focus each) hit the attacked enemy.

CARD.THE_BALL.note: Multiplayer only: +10 (+15) damage after each play, and after a play it moves to a random other player's draw pile, so in co-op you usually play it once. Sim keeps it in your deck.

CARD.THE_BOMB.note: Explodes for 40 (50) to all at end of the 2nd turn after play; exact within the 3-turn window.

CARD.THE_HUNT.note: Fatal bonus is a card reward only

CARD.THE_SCYTHE.note: Each play permanently adds +5 (up +7) dmg to the deck copy; 13 assumes a fresh copy

CARD.THE_SEALED_THRONE.note: Gain 1 star just BEFORE each card you play resolves (counts for that card's starsGainedThisTurn).

CARD.THINKING_AHEAD.note: Draws 2, then puts 1 hand card on top of draw pile; modeled as net draw 1.

CARD.THRASH.note: Eats a random hand Attack and adds its damage to this card for good; growth estimated as +6 (a Strike) per play.

CARD.THRUMMING_HATCHET.note: Returns to hand at the start of the next turn.

CARD.THUNDER.note: Unpowered damage to the enemy that Lightning evoke hit.

CARD.TOOLS_OF_THE_TRADE.note: the extra card is part of the hand draw in game (should not fire Speedster's excludeTurnDraw trigger)

play.note: card attacks vs a Weak target deal xN dmg (2 on first play, +1 per extra play)

CARD.TRACKING.note: needs enemy Weak, which the spec omits

CARD.TRANSFIGURE.note: Chosen hand card gets +1 cost and an extra play EVERY time this combat; modeled for the next card played only

CARD.TRUE_GRIT.note: Base exhausts a random hand card (pick:random); upgraded exhausts a chosen one (the least valuable).

CARD.TUTOR.note: Multiplayer only: the chosen player puts a card from their draw pile into their hand; cannot target self. Nothing for you.

CARD.TYRANNY.note: +1 hand draw each later turn, then exhaust 1 card of your choice from hand.

CARD.UNDEATH.note: Adds a copy of itself to the discard pile

CARD.UNDERWORLD.note: Multiplayer only: until the enemy turn ends, other players' attack damage also applies that much Doom (yours and Osty's do not). No allies in sim.

CARD.UNRELENTING.note: Next Attack played from hand costs 0; persists across turns until used.

CARD.UPROAR.note: Then plays a random Attack from the DRAW pile for free (playable ones first); no op for that.

CARD.VEILPIERCER.note: The next Ethereal card played from hand costs 0

CARD.VOID_FORM.note: ENDS YOUR TURN (no endTurn op: modelled as losing remaining energy). From next turn first 2 cards cost 0 energy AND 0 stars.

CARD.VOLTAIC.note: Counts every Lightning channeled this combat, incl. Cracked Core and power channels.

CARD.WASTE_AWAY.note: Knowledge Demon boss-choice card (applies a debuff power to you); never in your deck.

CARD.WELL_LAID_PLANS.note: From now on the whole hand is kept at the end of every turn (the hand is not discarded).

CARD.WHITE_NOISE.note: Uniform over Defect Powers of Common/Uncommon/Rare (no Ancient); costs 0 this turn.
